description: Example cross-skill combination rules. Catalog rows keep their own numbers; this document says how they combine when more than one listed skill is selected.

similarSkillGroups.label: Acrobatics, Gymnastics, and Aerobic Athletics
similarSkillGroups.notes: If Acrobatics and Gymnastics are selected, add physical bonuses. Duplicated abilities use the best proficiency; educational bonus once. Sense of Balance from Aerobic Athletics joins that best-of pool. Bundled Prowl/Climb from Acrobatics/Gymnastics do not increase with level unless separately selected.
